Querying MedCP for antidepressant utilization among patients ≥65 years old by drug class.

arguments.sql_query:
/* Step 1: identify major antidepressant classes in OMOP hierarchy */
WITH
  /* Map antidepressants to their ATC or drug_classes using concept_ancestor */
  ad_tx AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, ancestor.concept_id AS class_id, ancestor.concept_name AS class_name
    FROM omop.concept c
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor aa ON c.concept_id = aa.descendant_concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept ancestor ON ancestor.concept_id = aa.ancestor_concept_id
    WHERE ancestor.vocabulary_id = 'ATC'
      AND LENGTH(ancestor.concept_code) IN (3, 4)          -- ATC level 2 or 3
      AND aa.min_levels_of_separation <= 3                 /* parent */
      AND ancestor.standard_concept = 'S'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT DISTINCT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, NULL, NULL   /* sentinel; actual class from drug_era */
    FROM omop.concept c
    WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'RXNOM'                           /* standard RxNorm codes */
  ),
/* Use drug_era (grouped by class) instead of mapping ancestor — cleaner for OMOP */
rx AS (
    SELECT er.drug_concept_id,
           er.drug_exposure_start_date::date AS start_dte,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(er.drug_exposure_start_datetime, TO_DATE(cast(p.birth_date as varchar), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS age_at_rx_year
      FROM omop.drug_era er
      JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = er.drug_concept_id
      AND LENGTH(c.concept_code) IN (7, 8)                 /* ATC-level codes in OMOP */
      AND c.vocabulary_id   = 'ATC'
      AND c.standard_concept = 'S'
      JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = er.person_id
        AND op.observation_period_start_date <= er.drug_exposure_start_datetime
        AND op.observation_period_end_date   >= er.drug_exposure_start_datetime
      JOIN omop.person p   ON p.person_id = er.person_id )
SELECT class_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS persons,
       MIN(age_at_rx_year) AS min_age, MAX(age_at_rx_year) AS max_age
FROM rx WHERE 1=0 LIMIT 0;
